issues.title: [Ticket 23 / Slice 248] Repair alternating activation and rerun Standard-2000 A-A
body: Repair the authority state machine that allowed one side to activate several Units before the opponent acted; same-side continuation is legal only after the opponent has passed.
First reproduce the historical prefix with one focused gate, then bind the same next-eligible-side rule through LegalSpace, Preview and Apply.
After repair, start a new Standard-2000 A-A room at revision 0. The invalid r46 match remains non-training defect evidence and cannot be resumed as acceptance.

issues.title: [Ticket 23 / Slice 248] Complete player-seat companion runtime and Web acceptance
body: Deliver the floating companion as a player-seat tactical adjutant with character card, world book, era/relationship state, layered persistent room memory, context budgeting, import/export and resumed sessions.
The companion may read the bound player's visible state and same-seat plans, but only infer opponent intent from public actions; facts, inference and confidence must be visibly separated.
Kimi owns explicitly scoped Web presentation slices. Codex owns permission walls, strategy-core reuse, room integration and final browser acceptance.

issues.title: [Ticket 23 / Slice 248] Close combat estimation and prediction-calibration loop
body: Implement advisory attack probability and fire-zone exchange for current and hypothetical legal formations without overriding Rules, Preview, Apply or Replay.
Persist typed opponent predictions and calibrate them as hit, partial, miss, unobservable or expired after accepted transitions.
Use an isolated clone of the relevant scene for A/B evaluation and monitor whether added risk information makes the agent pathologically conservative.

issues.title: [Ticket 25 / Slices 262–263] Close spatial formation strategy and natural-match canary
body: Complete agent-selectable formation/placement solving, final formation choice and public position reasoning for arbitrary legal Unit layouts.
Keep exact base-edge geometry, coherency, terrain, threat and Rules Preview binding; templates may seed search but may not replace free legal formation choice.
Close the missing natural-match formation canary and the remaining A-A/review acceptance without promoting advisory geometry to authority.

issues.title: [Ticket 23 / Slice 249] Evaluate WikiSkill and EvoTest for replay-driven Skill evolution
body: Compare the current Teach→ctx2skill→Memento/SkillOpt→held-out→complete-game promotion loop with WikiSkill and EvoTest using primary sources.
Cover multi-game reflection, scene-scoped counterfactual experiments, applicability conditions, conflict detection, local updates, paired seat-swap and rollback.
All test-time mutations remain quarantined candidates until held-out and complete-game evidence supports versioned promotion.

issues.title: [Ticket 26 / Slices 264–266] Build and compare two StarCraft II companion role packs
body: Build two complete commander companion packs with character card, world book, era/relationship state, layered memory, tactical voice and Web floating-window integration.
Compare role fidelity, continuity, seat permissions, fact/inference separation, tactical quality, hallucination and immersion under identical model, Skill, tool and token budgets.
Different characters receive identical rules and strategy permissions; personality differences cannot be reported as strategy improvements.

issues.title: [Ticket 14 / Slice 143] Complete Android physical-device acceptance
body: Run the deferred APK acceptance on one real authorized Android device after a device is available.
The receipt must cover install/cold start, API target classification, background/foreground reconnect and one room Preview/Apply/Replay journey without credential persistence.
Do not substitute browser or emulator evidence for the requested physical-device gate.
